evidence.detail: The only exact-v308 external owner is R361 SpriteStyleTransformer rs/l/n; no other class references rs/l/L.

The RGB transform computes max/min/chroma, derives a six-sector hue value, adds a normalized hue offset, wraps it modulo 1536 and reconstructs RGB from the shifted hue while preserving value/chroma relationships.

The transform clamps its blend percentage to 0..100 and linearly blends the original RGB channels with the hue-shifted RGB output; helper overloads normalize the hue offset and reuse the same blend path.
SpriteStyleTransformer applies the resulting transformed RGB only to non-transparent Sprite pixels while preserving alpha, including cached style variants.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the hue-shift/blend color utility used exclusively by SpriteStyleTransformer.
